text:
maria: Heads-up — starting prod deploy for redwood/api v2026.03.15 but deploybot flagged the eu mirror with a provenance/manifest mismatch. Holding the rollout. @sam @jen can you take a look? Logs pasted below.

deploy-bot: publish step failed for redwood/api:v2026.03.15 in eu-west-1 — error=ECR_PROVENANCE_DIFF, detail=manifest digest references missing layer, build=6421abc

sam: quick guess — could be the multi-arch manifestlist ordering or a delayed arm64 layer replication. Saw something similar last week.

maria: Confirming: primary has linux/arm64 layer sha256:7f4e... but eu replica returns 404 for that blob. Error snippet: "manifest list references nonexistent layer sha256:7f4e..."

jen: +1 to doing a short retag and canary in eu. Suggest retag to v2026.03.15-rc1 and force a local put-image in eu to avoid the cross-region replication race. Update release notes to call out a transient deploy hold.

sam: I can run the retag + push. Proposed plan: 1) fetch manifest from primary, 2) put-image with new tag in eu, 3) cosign re-sign, 4) trigger canary. Anyone opposed?

kai: Heads-up — if you retag you need to re-sign the manifest (cosign) otherwise our attestation checks will block promotion. Also mark this as an ephemeral retag in release metadata for compliance.

maria: Agreed. If you start the retag, @security please watch the cosign audit. Change window still open until 23:00 UTC.

sam: Starting retag now. Commands I'm using:
```bash
# fetch manifest from primary
aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name redwood/api --image-ids imageTag=v2026.03.15 --query 'images[0].imageManifest' > manifest.json
# push same manifest with new tag into eu registry
aws ecr put-image --repository-name redwood/api --image-tag v2026.03.15-rc1 --image-manifest file://manifest.json
```

deploy-bot: manual trigger received for redwood/api:v2026.03.15-rc1 — canary deploy started in eu-west-1 (status: in_progress)

jen: Drafting a brief release note: "Temporary retag to v2026.03.15-rc1 due to mirror digest mismatch; original tag will be re-used after attestation and cosign re-signing. No functional changes." Will post to release channel.

security: FYI I've kicked off a quick audit on cosign signatures for the retag. Please don't promote v2026.03.15-rc1 to permanent tag until I ack.

sam: Canary succeeded. eu mirror now reports manifest parity; re-ran cosign sign and uploaded attestations.

maria: Thanks — proceeding with full rollout. Triggering deploybot main rollout now. Monitoring dashboards for error spikes and token-level latency.

deploy-bot: full rollout initiated. Auto-rollback target is v2026.02.28 if errors exceed threshold. Will alert #incidents on >=5% error rate.

kai: Postmortem action: add a pre-push manifest parity check to deploybot to catch replication gaps before tagging. Recommend a short blocking check for destination blob availability.

jen: I'll add the release note and a small blurb to the changelog about transient eu deploy replication lag and retag procedure.

maria: Closing the hold — thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.
